Medior/Senior Functional Analyst - (Insurance domain) M/V/X
Référence 5906612
|
Créé le 23 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée déterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
About the job
TMC is looking for multiple experienced
IT Functional Analysts
to join a dynamic IT environment responsible for the development and maintenance of business-critical applications. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating functional requirements into clear and structured solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives. The role offers the opportunity to work within a large-scale enterprise environment undergoing continuous digital evolution and modernization.
Profil
The ideal candidates have at least
4 years of experience (of which at least 2 years as a Functional Analyst)
, preferably within the insurance sector, and is comfortable engaging directly with business stakeholders. Experience with underwriting processes in Non-Life insurance is highly valued, while exposure to claims management, document management, SQL, project methodologies (Prince2), and test management practices (TMAP) is considered an asset. Strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, a structured approach, and a customer-oriented mindset are essential for success in this role.
As part of the team, you will be responsible for analysing business needs, designing functional solutions, preparing and executing integration tests, validating deliverables, and supporting the implementation of new functionalities. You will collaborate closely with developers, technical analysts, project managers, and business representatives to ensure high-quality solutions that meet user expectations. This is a long-term assignment based in the Brussels region, offering a hybrid working model with a combination of on-site presence and remote work. We are looking for people who master at least 1 national language, and English.
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
We would like to offer the possibility of joining our team at TMC internally, as a true
EMPLOYEUR,
enjoying all the benefits our company has to offer. If you think you'd be the perfect match, but you are currently working as a freelancer, we can also consider your application.
